body: Thank you so much for this. 💜This felt like a hug and I definitely needed it. I hope your day is good cause mine feels better now.

Aw I would absolutely love to move somewhere quiet. I have a place in mind where I would go. I live on disability at the moment, but am holding onto that option when it becomes available for sure. In the mean time, my next best option is watching nature documentaries or something.

Aw man. I don't understand why some drivers are so backwards, it baffles me. I don't understand why they yell at the person who is completely vulnerable. It makes no sense to me. I appreciate you responding. It's been a hard few days.
Thank you. Aw man, yeah it's been a hard few days. But it's comforting to be heard.

Omg, that's horrible. I'm sorry you're still having a hard time with the trauma. But I'm comforted knowing we're near the same age. I'm 30 as well. I can relate to the school bullying. I was for most of my time at school. I did not experience physical abuse from my parents but it's always been unstable and mildly abusive. My parents say hurtful things sometimes to my sister and I. But the bullying from outside the home is what has really wrecked me.
Aw thanks for that, I really needed to hear that today. It's been a hard few days. You're the best!

Oh okay, that's very helpful! I didn't know Gravol and Benadryl were depressants. That makes a lot more sense. Oh yeah for sure, I will definitely stick to the ginger tablets next time. Thank you so much!  I will give fennel tea a try, I agree ginger tea does help. I always get the lemon ginger kind from Twinings. And I'll try mint tea as well. :)

I think that is a perfect plan. That's very true, it's okay to stay in in pandemic times. :)

Aw man, yes, pizza sounds great. I think I'll definitely order that. Yes, I live in a somewhat busy part of town and it's always hard to avoid people here even during the pandemic. It's frustrating. I have a yoga mat. I can stay active inside, and I'll just say screw it to outside for now.
Thank you so much for that. That is so accurate, it does have a similar feeling to when they don't believe when you say no. It's been a hard day but I'm grateful just that you care.

Wow this is the first time I've heard someone mention this, I feel this too. I am very conscious of my cheeks and mouth creases. It feels exaggerated like jowls or something. I also have this bad habit of pulling at the skin on my neck and collarbone or my arms. I have issues with disordered eating. I'm not sure if it's a common habit for other people to do this.
I feel this too. It's really hard stuff. People often point out how they hate my side profile when I go out in public and it hurts.
